text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I was actually supposed to treat 
everyone to my cooking today...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, I ended up burning it... Even 
though everyone was looking forward to it, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her to mess up cooking, she must be 
utterly exhausted. Maybe I should 
reconsider her race schedule.
